title: Contacts & resources
slide_intent: Give readers a next step after studying the guidelines so they can find templates, ask a question or share a local example.
strategic_value: Special Olympics can keep communications teams connected beyond the publication through a central resource location and a named contact channel.
demonstration: The upper block highlights a resource address and email in bold and invites examples from programs. An acknowledgements block below names contributors to the guideline process.
practical_value: Use the resource address printed on the page to identify the intended toolkit and the email as the book’s designated point for questions.

content_islands.name: Resource and contact block
content_islands.spec: Place three paragraphs beneath the title. Emphasize the resource address and email within the text and close with the request for case studies.

content_islands.name: Acknowledgements
content_islands.spec: Leave space below the resource block, then set a small bold heading and two columns crediting the steering committee and design contributors.
